objectives.en: Hear the first sound in a spoken word.
objectives.yo: Gbọ́ ohùn àkọ́kọ́ nínú ọ̀rọ̀ tí a sọ.
objectives.pcm: Hear the first sound for word wey person talk.

objectives.en: Name the letter a familiar word starts with.
objectives.yo: Sọ lẹ́tà tí ọ̀rọ̀ tí o mọ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú.
objectives.pcm: Talk the letter wey word wey you sabi dey start with.

curriculum.objective: Say the sound each letter makes
curriculum.note: Lagos State teaches letter sounds across the whole of Nursery 1, from the sound of a in first term week 3; sounds come before letter names, so this no longer waits on the alphabet.

say.en: Listen well. Ball, bat, book start alike.
say.pcm: Listen well. Ball, bat, book start the same way.
say.yo: Fetí sílẹ̀ dáadáa. Ball, bat, book bẹ̀rẹ̀ bákan náà.

say.en: Today you will name first letters.
say.pcm: Today you go talk first letters.
say.yo: Lónìí, ìwọ yóò sọ lẹ́tà àkọ́kọ́.

say.en: Say A to E for me.
say.pcm: Talk A reach E for me.
say.yo: Sọ A dé E fún mi.

say.en: Words start with sounds, and sounds have letters. Ball starts with B. Sun starts with S.
say.pcm: Words dey start with sounds, and sounds get letters. Ball start with B. Sun start with S.
say.yo: Àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ohùn, ohùn sì ní lẹ́tà. Ball bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú B. Sun bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú S.

say.en: Let us try together. What letter starts dog?
say.pcm: Make we try together. Which letter dog start with?
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká gbìyànjú pọ̀. Lẹ́tà wo ni dog bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú?

say.en: Now your turn. What letter starts ball?
say.pcm: Na your turn now. Which letter ball start with?
say.yo: Ìwọ náà báyìí. Lẹ́tà wo ni ball bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú?

say.en: You listened well. Let us try that one again.
say.pcm: You listen well. Make we try that one again.
say.yo: O fetí sílẹ̀ dáadáa. Jẹ́ ká tún ọ̀kan yẹn gbìyànjú.

say.en: Last one. What letter starts mango?
say.pcm: Last one. Which letter mango start with?
say.yo: Ìkẹyìn. Lẹ́tà wo ni mango bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we find letters.
say.pcm: Well done. Tomorrow we go find letters.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó wá lẹ́tà.
